Zero-Hassle Auto-Publish Mode

When enabled, clicking Save on any tab automatically publishes your updates live to your connected Netlify site, Cloud DB, or GitHub repo in the background!

Option 1: 1-Click Complete Website (.ZIP) for Netlify Drop

100% Fixed • Includes All 22 Files & Images

Host on Netlify for free without tokens? Click below to download a complete, self-contained website ZIP containing your updated index.html, admin.html, portfolio-data.js, llms.txt, sitemap.xml, netlify.toml, and all 9 PNG/ICO images. Simply drag and drop this single ZIP into app.netlify.com!

Option 2: Direct Netlify 1-Click Live Deploy (No GitHub Needed!)

2-Second Live Deploy

Connect directly to Netlify! In Netlify, click your Avatar → User settings → Applications → New access token, and paste it below once. Whenever you click Save in any tab, your live site at itsomjmohite.netlify.app updates in ~2 seconds!

Ready for 1-click direct Netlify deployment.

Option 3: Instant Cloud JSON Database Sync (0.1s Zero-Rebuild Updates)

Want changes to appear in 0.1 seconds without even waiting for a Netlify deploy? Paste any free Firebase Realtime Database URL ending in /portfolio.json (or an npoint.io URL). Every Save pushes your data directly to the cloud!

Optional: Connect a Cloud JSON endpoint for 0.1s zero-rebuild updates.

Option 4: GitHub Auto-Commit (If Linked to GitHub)

Ready to commit to GitHub if your Netlify site is linked to a GitHub repository.
